Permafrost is a mage talent that increases the effectiveness of the mage's chill effects, reducing movement speed by an additional amount, up to 10% at max rank 3, and reduces the target's healing received by up to 10% at max rank 3. The additional reduction to movement speed is an additive amount, meaning that a snare that normally slows by 50% will now slow by 60%. This talent is popular with frost mages that do a lot of kiting, either against single mobs or when fighting multiple mobs at once.

Pewpew is a playful way to refer to Damage (role) -- especially ranged damage -- and its associated classes. Usually it is a teasing oversimplification of what DPSers are expected to do in a group: hit things quickly and repeatedly. It is also referenced in the expression less QQ, more pewpew, admonishing players to stop delaying play with discussion about nerfs, damage meters, or general arguing and simply just try harder at the task at hand. Pete Stillwell is the former senior producer of Classic Games. Stillwell watched a friend play Warcraft: Orcs & Humans, but was never allowed to play it. He eventually made enough money to buy a PC (by mowing neighbors' lawns), at which point StarCraft was released. He later played Warcraft III, which he has described as the game that made him want to work for Blizzard. He was involved in the continued development of StarCraft: Remastered, Warcraft III and Diablo II, and is the lead producer of Warcraft III: Reforged.

.]] A phylactery is a container of a lich's soul. They appear (albeit often fake) when a lich is killed. Mogu Shadow Ritualists also use phylacteries. They resemble their Burial Urns. Like with regular liches, troll liches use phylacteries for their souls as well.

A pickup group, or pug, is a group of random players that are grouped together via the Dungeon Finder or via other methods in an impromptu manner. Advertising your desire to form or join a group on trade chat is a popular way of pugging outside of using the Dungeon Finder. Note that the word "group" refers to the literal meaning of a group, i.e. players having a common objective, and is not limited to five persons (a party). Raids with pick-up players are still called a pug, despite being a raid. Piercing Howl is a tier 3 warrior class talent. It is an AoE Shout debuff that costs 10 Rage, and reduces movement speed of nearby enemies by 50% for 15 seconds. This effect is unaffected by diminishing returns. It is an exclusive choice node with Berserker Shout.

A pig is a domesticated descendant of the wild boar (colloquially called the boar). Pigs are much smaller than their wild cousins and are critters in Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos, while they are beasts and companions in WoW. They are often raised by orcs for meat in pig farms. Golden pig honors its ancestors by giving its allies good fortune. Druids think silver pigs have a special bond with golden pigs, as both breeds appeared on Azeroth at the same time. A few pigs may, in fact, be polymorphed creatures. Unfamiliar pigs in unlikely habitats should be viewed with suspicion!
The Phantom Blade is a Level 44 quality One-Handed Sword with a Chance on hit to decrease a target's armor and prevent them from using stealth or turning invisible.
The Piercing Axe is a two-handed axe that gives a bonus to agility.

__NOTOC__ Phantim is a green drake found in Bough Shadow in Ashenvale. Phantim wanders Bough Shadow along with other, weaker dragonkin while helping guard one of the portals of Azeroth. The portal itself is guarded by Dreamstalker; it is believed to lead to the Emerald Dream.

__NOTOC__ Phalanx is an elite golem guarding the Grim Guzzler in Blackrock Depths. During peaceful bar times, Phalanx is friendly. If Private Rocknot drinks too many Dark Iron Ale Mugs and decides to make a ruckus, Phalanx will quickly turn into a hostile enemy.

__NOTOC__ Phin Odelic was originally a human quest giver located in Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He was a former member of the Kirin Tor, and a cousin to Farmer Ray. He once led a group of adventurers who investigated odd happenings in the Southshore area. Two of his companions were Quae and Kinelory, who were investigating rumors of a new plague created by the Forsaken at Go'Shek Farm in the Arathi Highlands.

Phase spiders are ethereal beings. They step across the planes of Outland to hunt the unwary. Phase spiders are a type of spider native to Outland, and make their home in the Twisting Nether. They often attack in clusters.
__NOTOC__ Phea is a draenei cooking vendor located at the Seat of the Naaru in the Exodar. During the Battle for the Exodar, she was inside Velen's protective shield.
Phantom Valets are human ghostly servants found in Karazhan. They are worth 15 Violet Eye reputation when killed.
:"Sic... them... all." - Kristoff Manchester Phase Hounds are darkhounds found in the Servants' Quarters of Karazhan.
Phoenix-fire Band is the reward for players who complete Trial of the Naaru: Magtheridon, given by A'dal.
Phaseshift Bulwark is obtained from the same-named weapon during the encounter against the final boss in The Eye. See Kael'thas Sunstrider (tactics). Lord Sanguinar was seen using one.
Phantasmal Headdress is a quest reward from I Work... For the Horde! and Waste Not, Want Not (quest).
Piece of Krom'zar's Banner is looted from Krom'zar's Banner in Northern Barrens after killing Warlord Krom'zar.

Picking Up The Pieces... is a once-daily collection quest, having players recover 15 Nethermine Cargo crates. This quest is the followup to The Netherwing Mines, available at reputation with Netherwing.
Pheonix Hawks are dragonhawks found in Tempest Keep and The Eye.

Phoenix-Hawk Hatchling can be found in Tempest Keep and The Eye. When Phoenix-Hawk Hatchling is tamed by a hunter it teaches Fire Breath Rank 2. Fire Breath Rank 2 will requires 25 points to train your other pets.

Phlogiston is a substance in the Vial of Phlogiston and the only known maker is the fabled quilboar, Roogug. It was needed for creating the needed level of extreme heat. Water Pincers on the Wandering Isle spits Phlogiston that inflicts fire damage.
Phial of Scrying is provided for The Master's Glaive (quest). This item is a quest reward from Onu is meditating.
The Piece of Threshadon Carcass is taken from a Fresh Threshadon Carcass in the Marshlands of Un'Goro Crater.
Phantasmal Substance drops from Phantasmal Seekers in Windrunner Village in the Ghostlands.
Phantom Hounds can be found in Karazhan. They are summoned by Phantom Guardsmen.

The first samples of phlogiston were collected in the labs of dwarven tinkers in Khaz Modan when dwarves used a vacuum pump to collect the superheated air over a kettle of molten iron. In the years since, the process has been much refined, leading to the development of the phlogiston collector. This wagon-sized machine has a large intake valve to pull air into a reserve over a glowing crucible. Once the device separates and purifies the phlogiston, it bubbles it into a mixture of oil and water to capture it. The machine then siphons the liquid into glass vials. in Durotar.]] Pig farms are a staple of orcish society, trapping, breeding and raising the numerous boars required to feed the hungry members of the Horde. Not all orcish farms are about raising boars but they represent the majority of them.

The Phase-Hunter is one of the two creatures that can be released during the first wave of the Harbinger Skyriss encounter in the Arcatraz. It is a warp stalker with a currently-unique skin (olive green with blue stripes and yellow eyes).
A phantom is another term for an undead spirit or ghostly image.
A phosphorescent crystal was used as a light source, by some (usually mages), by putting them inside a container.

Pigment is a type of ingredient primarily used by the Inscription profession to produce inks. Using the milling subskill on five of any of the herbs listed will to create 2-4 common pigments. Occasionally, milling may also additionally produce 1-3 uncommon pigments (almost always 1), although these are found less frequently. ;Types of pigments See: Inscription ingredients for a list of inks made with these pigments. es:Pigmento
Phasing is a game design tool that changes outdoor areas of World of Warcraft, based on an individual player's accomplishments or quest progress.

Pierce's Pistol can be found inside the Dark Runed Chest after defeating Mal'Ganis in Culling of Stratholme on heroic mode. It was probably made (and maybe owned) by Robert Pierce, owner of Pierce's Pistols in Festival Lane. It is unknown how it ended up in Mal'Ganis's cache.
Pickled Fangtooth is created with Northrend Cooking (1); taught by trainers.
